summary: A retail and capital markets day dominated by major IPO activity—Jio Platforms seeking $114B valuation and planning October 21 launch, JSW One's ₹3,054 crore IPO, and McDonald's supplier HyFun planning $208M raise—alongside strong consumer durables growth forecasts and retail sector expansion.

bullets.text: Jio Platforms seeks approximately $114 billion valuation in planned IPO launching October 21, per sources.
JSW One IPO of ₹3,054 crore advised by Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, Trilegal, and Khaitan & Co.
HyFun Foods, McDonald's supplier, plans ₹20 billion ($208 million) IPO for late 2028.
India's consumer durables market projected to reach ₹3-3.25 trillion by 2030.
Dabur India expects double-digit revenue growth in consolidated and India FMCG business for Q2 FY27.
